trigger_observation.interpretation: A retained cell is not evidence-complete merely because it exists in the 510-cell factory. EXECUTED_NO_TRIGGER is insufficient to claim a factor family was empirically tested when its native score column contained no populated evidence.

ORDER_FLOW_MICROSTRUCTURE.required_evidence: native tick/trade-flow plus executable spread/depth where available

CARRY_VALUE.required_evidence: asset-class-native rates/swaps/forwards, basis/yield, futures basis/dividends or term-structure/roll-yield

CRYPTO_FUNDING_BASIS.required_evidence: perpetual funding plus basis plus open-interest/liquidation evidence where historically obtainable

hard_lock: All 34 assets and all 15 strategy families remain in scope. Missing native evidence gates a family or cell; it never removes it from the universe and never authorizes a proxy performance claim.
